desc:
Build your village. Burn theirs. Grow your dragon into a giant.

🆕 DRAGON CREW UPDATE: you don't fly alone any more!
🐉 Two of your dragons fly beside you and breathe fire
⭐ Level up 4 skills, with a new perk at every level
🗡️ Swords! Fight robbers on foot and forge better blades
🦅 Griffins grab your loot now. Burn them to win it back

🏰 Build your own village and burn other players' villages
🔥 Fight the Storm Titan in your first minute
🥚 Hatch and ride 10 kinds of dragon, plus rare mutations. Collect all 64!
🏘️ Burn 50+ villages and forts, then fly the loot home before the griffins catch you
👑 Win back the 6 Crown Stones from the Robber King
🌀 Fight through the Void: a boss every 5th wave
🏁 Race 19 sky courses for a world record
🌙 Moon Eggs hatch overnight
🎁 Free gifts every day
⚡ Admin Hour every Saturday, 1 PM EST

USE CODE 🎁BURNAVILLAGE🎁 FOR FREE GIFTS
